name: nimiqearn-quest
description: Telegram-native task and bounty marketplace for the Nimiq ecosystem

scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.dev: node init && pnpm build:packages && pnpm --parallel --filter @nimiqearn/api --filter @nimiqearn/web dev
scripts.dev:all: node init && pnpm build:packages && pnpm --parallel --filter @nimiqearn/api --filter @nimiqearn/web --filter @nimiqearn/bot dev
scripts.build: node init && pnpm db:generate && pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @nimiqearn/api --filter @nimiqearn/bot --filter @nimiqearn/web build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm db:generate && pnpm build:packages && pnpm -r typecheck
